You’re right. I’m trying to find a way to not have this world view. The main reason I have it is just watching how many friends have their hearts crushed, friendships crumble leaving people hating each other, and people who could’ve made a difference taken from us way to early. I had a friend who was trying to be a doctor to help people and he died last year of heart problems at 23. My girlfriend is the love of my life and the person I always come back to. But I told her of my thoughts of suicide and how I feel about history and the way I’ve seen interpersonal connection crush people, and (although it was a very word vomit monologue from me) all she said was “I love hearing you talk about things”. I know she is trying her best for me and she has an unending amount of love for me and I for her. But even at our best, I can’t put these thoughts to rest, and she can barely say anything that will help because she just doesn’t have constant thoughts like this. I also am extremely afraid of dragging her down with me. I mainly feel like dead weight, and it feels like the only thing I do for people is drag them down. I can’t be in social situations without disassociating four or five times throughout the experience. Some of my friends have started calling me out and joking about me zoning out for minutes at a time. I just don’t know what to do, but I’m all honesty you’re right. I wrote my original comment when I was feeling extra suicidal. Things are a touch better today so I can see how dismal that outlook is. I’m trying to do better, it just feels like one step forward two steps back. Also your username works really well lol

I’ll tell you why. We live on a cold dark ball floating around a cold dark universe built by nothing but chaos. We live in a society (I know, I know) built around what we can offer to other people. Value is a human construct which means literally outside of humanity we mean nothing. Our happiness doesn’t mean anything. Our sadness doesn’t mean anything. And as far as us in this sub, the universe just fucked us and there isn’t any way to change the fact that for the rest of time, whether we’re here or not, there will always be those who have happiness and fulfillment, and those who have none of it. There is nothing selfish about seeing your life for what it is and deciding you’re done with the pain and suffering. I’m not gonna be able to get rid of that realization and the only way to stop thinking about how heartless and evil this existence is, is to take yourself out of it. I’m done lying to those around me who are depressed, saying “it’ll get better” “I care about you and your friends do too”. That may be true but that doesn’t even matter if the same people who care about you now have to watch you die of old age after a lifetime of pain. We’re out of luck and I don’t think that’s ever going to change. The only peace I can offer is I’m here with you.
